classification: Historical NASA map composites with illustrative cloud evolution and accelerated rotation. Not live weather, a climate simulation or a current Earth orientation.
limits: Scientific is a restrained visualization mode, not a physically solved atmosphere or measured cloud altitude.
Cloud drift, distortion and changing opacity are invented illustration; NASA's cloud mosaic has manually filled gaps and is not a time series.
Day 2004, night 2016 and historical cloud maps do not share an epoch or the catalog's J2000 positions.
Atmosphere thickness, illumination exposure, ocean roughness and night-light intensity are display choices; Artistic exaggerates their visibility.
No elevation displacement or water mask is used. No current orientation, seasonal lighting or weather forecast is implied.
This is an editable Blender proof only; no app integration or glTF animation equivalence is claimed.
